newsitem.title: FRANCE: French capital markets closing report.
newsitem.headline: French capital markets closing report.

text.p: French 10-year bond futures settled slightly higher but off their highest levels of the day, hit by profit-taking late in the session, dealers said.
The contract had been boosted early in the day by two big purchases carried out for domestic and non-domestic investors, pushing the notionnel to a new contract high of 130.16.
But the bond future retreated later to close up just eight basis points at 129.96. The announcement of a major 10 billion franc issue to be launched next week weighed on the market, said one dealer.

One dealer said the market appeared to be overbought in the short-term and needed to retreat. He said, however, that non-residents were eyeing 132.0 as a target before the end of the summer. "The trend remains bullish in the medium term but we are toppish even if the market is pretty solid," he said.
Another dealer said he expected the market to establish itself in a range between 130.50 and 129.72/74 which he said constituted a solid area of support.
Next week, the market was expected to be quiet with dealers starting their holidays.
